pages.text: For walking in on a transmitter. Right click to set its frequency in MHz (it starts on 146.520). Hold it, in either hand, while a station transmits there: it $(thing)beeps and blinks$(), from once a second facing away to ten a second pointed straight at it, higher and louder as you get closer.$(br2)It only hears by line of sight, never skip, and plays none of the station's audio.
